questions: r158: "When a change list that `work run` reads names the glossary, `work run` shall write a `drafted` glossary-proposal with the terms the change list adds, changes and removes in the glossary." Reading A: only an integrate round's change list gives a glossary-proposal, as in r159. Reading B: every change list work run reads gives one, an apply round's included (r145); then an apply round applying a glossary-proposal's drafts would give a new drafted glossary-proposal, against r166.

r160: "While a glossary-proposal is `awaiting-answer`, `work run` shall start no round of the kind `apply` for it." Reading A: no apply round while it is awaiting-answer and some question has no answer; once all are answered r165 starts the apply round. Reading B: no apply round while the status is awaiting-answer whatever the answers; but r169 sets that status at gate end and an answered proposal still has it, so r165 could never hold.
